convex_hull — 3D bounds op

• Data kinds: points → mesh

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.convex_hull(V) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import meshrepair; meshrepair.convex_hull(V), registry से लेना हो तो ops3d.get("convex_hull"))

उपयोग

point cloud का convex hull -> बाहर की ओर oriented triangles के साथ (V, F)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Thin wrapper over scipy.spatial.ConvexHull (Qhull): interior points are dropped, faces are triangulated, and each triangle is wound so its normal points away from the hull centroid (outward, positive signed volume) — so the result feeds straight into inertia_tensor or a MuJoCo convex collider. Needs at least 4 non-coplanar points.
